Live census (2026-09-13, single-partition reads on every named candidate plus the base and refractor-num-10 addresses) found the bmabwj and cpa-bwi partitions EMPTY -- those exact keys do not exist as stored sold_comps rows today -- but confirmed the underlying defect the trace was pointing at: 4 real sales sit at the sibling cardId hiq:baseball:2020:bowman:cpa-bwj:base:auto (product segment 'bowman' instead of 'bowman-chrome', all from the cardsight source, all with titles that explicitly read '...Chrome Auto...'), 1 base-partition row already carries a third-slug hobbyiqCardId naming that same wrong 'bowman' address, and the orphaned null-cardNumber row (reslugedFrom hiq:baseball:2020:bowman-chrome::base:auto, catalogUnplacedReason 'superseded by the clean checklistcenter re-ingest') is an unfolded duplicate of an already-present base sale. card_catalog point-reads confirm hiq:baseball:2020:bowman-chrome:cpa-bwj:base:auto (source checklistcenter-2026-08-29, verificationStatus verified, confidence 0.95) and hiq:baseball:2020:bowman-chrome:cpa-bwj:refractor:auto:num-10 both exist and are checklist-backed; no hiq:baseball:2020:bowman:cpa-bwj:* address (base or refractor) has any card_catalog row at all -- the 'bowman' partition is unattested and exists only because the cardsight ingest wrote setName='Bowman' verbatim while every one of its own titles names the Chrome product.
rulings: One card, one row, one pool: sales of the SAME physical 2020 Bowman Chrome #CPA-BWJ autograph must resolve to ONE sold_comps pool, keyed on the checklist-backed card_catalog address. A card-number typo or a mis-derived product segment is the same card, not a different one.

CF-IT-CAME-OUT-OF-BOWMAN does not apply here in reverse: unlike the 2026 CPA-MG precedent (data/pool-relocations/2026-09-12-cpa-mg-bowman-chrome-to-bowman.json), where Chrome Prospect Autographs are genuinely 2026 BOWMAN (paper) cards with zero Bowman Chrome checklist presence, 2020 Bowman Chrome CPA-BWJ is checklist-backed under bowman-chrome (card_catalog point-read confirmed, checklistcenter-2026-08-29, verified) and has NO card_catalog row under plain bowman at any parallel. The direction of this fold is bowman -> bowman-chrome, the opposite of the CPA-MG list, decided per-product by the checklist each time, never by name collision alone.

The title decides the parallel: three of the four 'bowman'-partitioned sales state no parallel word beyond the product name and grade (Base auto), and relocate to the base address. The fourth (cardsight::d8e4d85c712470a6f7590688) states 'Refractor' with printRun 10 and a 'BGS 9/10' grade format matching /10 -- its own stored hobbyiqCardId already reads the correct refractor:auto:num-10 address; only its cardId partition is wrong. Both destination addresses (base and refractor:auto:num-10) are point-read confirmed checklist-backed in card_catalog.

A moved row carries ONE identity: every RELOCATE entry lands both cardId and hobbyiqCardId at the target, per relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs's own planRelocatedIdentity rule. fromCardId is each row's STORED cardId (the partition key), never its hobbyiqCardId.
Grades are not identity: BGS/PSA grade fields on every row are left as stored. Only the two address fields move.

The null-cardNumber orphan (ebay-user-purchase::holding::8bb15382-6e68-4a56-8683-adc21281e2c4) shares its title, image URL and __imagePhash-eligible listing with the ebay-user-sale row already resident at the base address, but is not marked as a __phashDuplicate of it, so it is RELOCATED rather than retired -- consolidating both onto the base pool keeps them both readable and lets any later phash pass make the duplicate call rather than this list guessing it.
